doc.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08

chapter: Eureka Brass Band and Sonny Henry
title: Sonny Henry on Jim and trombone styles
summary: Sonny Henry talks about Jim, a trombonist friend he claims to have helped learn to talk, and compares players.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: I heard him a couple of times, but I think he's most of his man. Of course he can play. You see Jim, him and Jim is all in the same style. Anytime he's sitting there they're going to play it. They're going to play it naturally too. But I think he's most of a-

Well what is he a real teen? Yeah. You see that's the thing I didn't know. I'm telling you right now back in those days I didn't know. All I'd know I used to just go to the dancers they could sit down there and play it. I wouldn't know if he was playing my head or not.

I know that he wasn't a man on my top or Harrison Bond. Lewis Nelson wasn't on the top of him. He was a good man. Just like Jim. Now what did he call me? Jim. He said, hello Mr. Jim. I said hello. But my name is not Jim. He called me Jim but my name is not Jim. I said Jim I said okay I said how you feel? Okay. Because he just said I and Jim is a brother. Of course we kind of feel with him. And when we talk we almost talk like sometimes. But he's no kid at all.
You taught him drum on and taught him how to talk too?

No no no. Not at all. Wait wait wait a minute. It looks that way. Wait wait wait a minute. God damn. Wait wait wait a minute. I couldn't talk oneself. How can I just try? I couldn't talk oneself. But Kicks let me tell you a kid. He said sometime when he and I get together. I said partner? I said I'm learning how to talk good. He gave me a lesson you started. I find him out sometime you see.
Well did they tell me that Sonny was Jim's uncle though?

No. Your uncle? No. We used to know Ken at all. Yeah. You did know him of course down in the country. Oh yeah I know him so long. Yeah. I know him. I understand first. I understand. Yeah. And I said everybody and I think I'm the his teacher. But the idea of him but then sometime he used to get to talking. I said partner I say you are learning good how to talk. I said just keep on using it.
